negative_findings.description: Searched in Macedonian and English for a КЗК (competition commission) decision specifically about payment cards, interchange or card acquiring in North Macedonia.
negative_findings.result_summary: No such decision surfaced in search results. Only generic КЗК contact/legal-framework pages and unrelated sectors (retail chains, chamber of commerce) appeared. The КЗК decision registers exist but their contents were not indexed by the search engine at case level.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Cannot yet confirm whether North Macedonia has any public competition case touching card/payment markets. The registers must be crawled directly rather than relied on via search.

negative_findings.description: Looked for an NBRSM page listing supervisory measures, fines or misdemeanour proceedings imposed on individual banks/payment institutions.
negative_findings.result_summary: Found the supervision hub and the 'Одлуки од областа на супервизијата' regulatory page, but no evidence of a per-institution enforcement/sanctions register. NBRSM appears to publish the rules and licence-related decisions rather than a named sanctions list.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: If no named-sanctions register exists, enforcement intelligence on PSPs must be reconstructed from Службен весник, annual supervision reports, court records and press — a much higher-cost collection path.

negative_findings.description: Searched in Macedonian for a National Bank consumer-complaints channel for bank/PSP users comparable to the Serbian NBS 'приговор' system.

coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run a dedicated crawler over the Cyrillic-path category pages and their /images/YYYY/ and /sites/default/files/ PDF directories, building a case-level index (case number, parties, date, sector).

coverage_gaps.description: Службен весник на РСМ (Official Gazette) was not scouted as a source in this pass, yet it is where licence withdrawals, sanctions and supervisory decisions become legally public.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Scout slvesnik.com.mk / the official gazette portal for a searchable archive and subscription/access terms; it is likely the authoritative fallback for the missing NBRSM sanctions register.

coverage_gaps.description: Administrative Court (Управен суд) and Misdemeanour court decisions on appeals against КЗК/НБРСМ/АЗЛП actions were not directly scouted (only the КЗК's own court-decisions page).
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Scout the judicial portal (sud.mk) and the court decisions database for a searchable corpus, and assess whether party names are anonymised.

coverage_gaps.description: North Macedonia is officially bilingual (mk/sq) and institutions such as ДЗР brand themselves as 'Enti Shtetëror i Revizionit', but the run's language scope is mk+en only, so Albanian-language enforcement/audit publications were not searched.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: If scope allows, add sq terms (Enti Shtetëror i Revizionit, Komisioni për Mbrojtjen e Konkurrencës, prokurim publik) to catch documents published only in Albanian.

coverage_gaps.description: Internal audit / public internal financial control (Централна единица за хармонизација, Министерство за финансии PFM monitoring) reports were only glimpsed via a Ministry of Finance PFM monitoring document and not scouted as a standing source.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Scout finance.gov.mk and arhiva.finance.gov.mk for the annual PIFC/PFM reports, which aggregate internal-audit findings including IT and procurement weaknesses.

coverage_gaps.description: e-nabavki.gov.mk is an ASP.NET application whose data sits behind .aspx grids and .asmx services; no confirmed bulk-export or open-data endpoint was identified.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Test whether the portal exposes an open-data/API export or whether headless-browser scraping is required, and check the portal terms of use for scraping constraints before scaling collection.

brief: North Macedonia's audit-and-enforcement trail is anchored by four institutional registers that all publish in Macedonian: the State Audit Office (dzr.mk) with final audit reports plus a forward-looking planned-audits list and a dedicated central-bank audit area; the Commission for Protection of Competition (kzk.gov.mk) with separate administrative, misdemeanour, court and merger-notification streams — the merger notifications alone already disclose bank ownership moves such as the 2026 AIK Grup / Podravska Banka filing; the State Commission for Public Procurement Appeals (dkzjn.gov.mk) where losing bidders name rival IT and payment vendors and disputed specifications; and the e-procurement portal (e-nabavki.gov.mk) that carries the underlying award and concluded-contract notices. Around these sit useful secondary and complementary sources: the anti-corruption commission (dksk.mk), which opens cases directly off audit findings and has a cooperation memorandum with the National Bank, the data-protection agency (azlp.mk), the FOI platform slobodenpristap.mk as a legal route to unpublished documents, the consumer organisation ОПМ for grievances against financial-service providers, and Macedonian media as a change-detector over registers that are poorly indexed. Two structural weaknesses stand out: the National Bank publishes supervision rules and licence/consent decisions but no visible per-institution sanctions register, and no MK consumer-complaint statistics by bank/PSP were found — both likely require the Official Gazette, court records or FOI to reconstruct. Practical access notes: dzr.mk returned 403 to an automated fetch (bot-defended, unverified rather than dead), the English-language KZK decisions path 404s while the Cyrillic path is live, and the appeals commission appears under three hosts whose canonical instance is unresolved.
